description: Installment sale (Form 6252) — Offline installment-method calculator (IRC 453, Form 6252): contract price, gross profit percentage, excess mortgage over basis, amortized seller-financed note payments, and a year-by-year schedule of principal, interest income and taxable installment gain (recapture taxed in year 1), with imputed-interest, 453A and related-party notes. Params: sale_price, basis (required); selling_costs, recapture, debt_assumed, down_payment, years (default 10), rate (annual %), payments_per_year (default 12). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_installment_sale
